# simplevm_project (Data Source)

Reads a SimpleVM project, by default the one the API key belongs to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "simplevm_project" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Project ID. When omitted, the project the API key is scoped to is returned.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_activated` (Boolean) Whether clusters are activated for the project.
- `cores_limit` (Number) Maximum number of CPU cores.
- `description` (String) Project description.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the project is disabled.
- `ram_limit` (Number) Maximum amount of RAM (GB).
- `shortname` (String) Short name of the project.
- `vms_limit` (Number) Maximum number of VMs.
- `volume_counter_limit` (Number) Maximum number of volumes.
- `volume_storage_limit` (Number) Maximum total volume storage (GB).
